purpose: Test the original LCIB initialization h0 and isolate its relational assignment, explicit reference cues, and new spatial hypotheses.
population: Exactly R165 ordinary 18620 direction records, six source-to-target directions. Target frames, A256, caption, 16384 samples, RGB, cameras, original R158 winner, frozen source and existing source-prepared weights are identical.
h0: Use the R162 source options, candidate initialization, initial support, likelihood and Relationships/choose. No support sweeps, parameter updates, geometry fitting or later LCIB cycles. Evaluate all reported boxes with the same R165/R155 PCA on frozen center and dimensions. Save original h0 readout before this common output-angle rule as a numerical diagnostic.
independent: Use exactly the full candidate banks and same unary and beam alternatives. Set both pairwise spatial and support-overlap costs to zero.
no_ref_role: Keep the same banks and role slots and all original relation and overlap terms. In the reference slots only, replace role-token attention and role-conditioned proposal priors with a common non-padded full-utterance seed attention. Rebuild reference supports and scores with the same equations. The banks retain upstream role-guided retrieval to isolate the LCIB reference-scoring contribution. This intervention does not alter the common R76/R91 score or remove the reference slot.
original_only: Keep the same per-role slot budget as the full bank, replacing new spatial candidates with the next distinct A256 candidates in the original R162 old-hypothesis order. Record any genuinely empty slots. Recompute the normal joint support and assignments for that bank with all relation and role evidence.
relation_subgroup: Before labels are read, use the frozen R162 parser's supported direct target-reference LEFT/RIGHT edges in the camera frame. Report separately rows with a nonzero visible candidate-pair cost. Other relation types stay in the full denominator.
box_metrics: R165 strict IoU >0.25 and >0.50. Top1 equals baseline bit by bit for R158. Same yaw-axis annotations and independent sensor-frame scorer. Report direction, target, overall six-direction macro, micro, and all signed changes.
identity_metrics: Compare the unique annotated instance supported by points in each output box. Use the common seed-vote owner (55% of the contained seed set, at least a 15-point percentage lead over runner-up or UNKNOWN, at least two distinct sampled seeds). Record wrong and UNKNOWN separately and keep unresolved predictions in the denominators. Compare with independent conservative box-owner assignment as sensitivity. The referred subject label is slot zero of the annotation inventory. For reference, distinguish prior independently verified image labels from the narrow annotation-derived proxy requiring a unique compatible class and consistent projected geometry. Report reference truth coverage, both endpoints correct by edge, and each endpoint. R158 has no native discrete reference output. A separately named R158 plus existing R88 reference readout is a diagnostic and does not modify the baseline subject.
coverage: On confirmed or proxy-reference edges, report coverage in original A256 seed regions, R88 top3, LCIB physical candidates, eligibility and beam shortlist, plus both-covered but selection-wrong. Report this on fixed label-eligible denominators and include all cases.
label_boundary: Freeze every prediction and candidate bank before identity adjudication or target IoU scoring. No target label feeds inference or thresholds. FINAL remains excluded through the R165 ordinary cohort. No training and no resumed baseline jobs.
